claims.reason: On valid tokens, the implemented denominator for a unit query is φ†Dφ, including nε, and the bias-free readout is φ†A_rφ/(φ†Dφ). Whitening gives the full closed eigenvalue interval, including its endpoints, with pure queries. Independent class queries make the product of the bias-shifted intervals attainable on one example.

The implemented orientation is E_i^dep = Σ_j |U_ij|² E_j. Row sums of |U|² preserve the εI term in each effect; column sums preserve D. Since U is fixed by the keys, the same interval and box argument applies.

claims.claim: Exact CE extrema and strict top-1 feasibility
claims.reason: CE is minimized at z_y = U_y and z_r = L_r for every rival, giving log(1 + Σ_{r≠y} exp(L_r − U_y)); reversing the endpoints gives the maximum. The best attainable true-minus-best-rival margin is U_y − max_{r≠y} L_r. A positive margin gives strict top-1; zero requires the tie policy.

The cubic path has edge weights a³ and b³; dividing by √(a⁶+b⁶) gives the stated r and s. From input amplitudes (1,a,0), the last-token contributions are (cos τ − 1)sr and −i sin(τ)sa. Their real cross term vanishes, so the stated probability excess is exact, positive at the implemented τ = 0.25, and identical after initial dephasing. Replacing f by the isolated g leaves only the ε floor there.

In the cited value sum, a query-orthogonal key has zero coefficient. Adding such a key, or replacing one orthogonal key with another, leaves a defined normalized output unchanged when all other terms are fixed.

limitations: The box is exact for arbitrary independent physical queries on one fixed example, not for the finite circuit family or a single query set shared across examples.

The supplied diagnostic compares bias-free readouts with bias-free bounds and reports actual route CE, not the relaxed CE extrema. Zero exceedances at tolerance 1e-8 do not certify exact membership. The 138/240 support count and the 0/320 readout counts are different tests on different cohorts.

CE strictly below both minima would separate the fixed readouts in loss, not establish causal mediation, trained-model superiority, or novelty. Dark-token activation in this example does not distinguish coherent from initially dephased transport.
